newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kohl to give news conference at 1500 GMT.
newsitem.headline: Kohl to give news conference at 1500 GMT.

text.p: German chancellor Helmut Kohl will give a news conference on Monday at 1500 GMT, his Christian Democratic Union (CDU) political party said in a statement.
The party's executive committee was meeting on Monday to discuss the federal budget for 1997 and 1998, and prospects for European monetary union (EMU).
Initially, CDU general secretary Peter Hintze was scheduled to give the news conference.
